traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Ixioliriaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear or lanceolate; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
